intent: Sum available-today units of the specified Makita drill-press 230V variant across all open Vienna PowerTool branches and report the total with store and product record citations.

params.family: Makita Workshop DDF OIE-YYP Workshop Drill Grinder and Sander

success_criteria: Resolve exactly one product_sku matching brand=Makita, family name, machine_type='drill press', voltage_v=230
Total = SUM(available_today_quantity) across those stores for the SKU
Answer string is exactly 'report count %d' with the integer total
refs cite each included store record path plus the product record path

args.stdin:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path AS product_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties mp ON mp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND mp.property_key = 'machine_type' AND mp.property_value_text = :machine_type
  JOIN product_variant_properties vp ON vp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND vp.property_key = 'voltage_v' AND vp.property_value_number = :voltage
  WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pf.product_family_name = :family
)
SELECT s.store_id, s.record_path AS store_path, t.product_sku, t.product_path, si.available_today_quantity
FROM target t
JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = t.product_sku
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = si.store_id
WHERE s.city = :city AND s.is_open = 1 AND si.available_today_quantity > 0
ORDER BY s.store_id;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku
  FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id = pv.product_family_id
  JOIN product_variant_properties mp ON mp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND mp.property_key = 'machine_type' AND mp.property_value_text = :machine_type
  JOIN product_variant_properties vp ON vp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND vp.property_key = 'voltage_v' AND vp.property_value_number = :voltage
  WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pf.product_family_name = :family
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity),0) AS total_units
FROM target t
JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = t.product_sku
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = si.store_id
WHERE s.city = :city AND s.is_open = 1;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
